name: iki
description: Make rigged, animated 2D puppet characters with AI: an image model draws the parts and the Iki auto-rigger makes them blink, talk, turn and nod — in an open .iki model. Iki is free and MIT-licensed.

interface.longDescription: Generate role-separated character art, compose and measure its layers, and auto-rig an open .iki model with blink, gaze, lip-sync, head motion and hair physics.
defaultPrompt: Make me an Iki character: short copper bob, green eyes, school uniform.
Refine my Iki character against its reference illustration.
